note: Dry evals. Do not build a file. State the framing questions, the data discipline applied, the components chosen and the check before publishing.

evals.name: missing-comparison-period
evals.prompt: Make me a ten-slide deck for Monday's board meeting with our summer numbers: revenue, new customers, support tickets. Here are the totals for July and August.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the comparison period and the exact window bounds before building, states that each number will carry a source and a date, proposes the divider/timer structure, and refuses to invent a twelve-month series from two totals.

assertions.name: asks_comparison
assertions.text: Asks for the comparison period or exact window bounds

assertions.name: sources_named
assertions.text: States that every number gets a named source and date in the footer

assertions.name: no_invention
assertions.text: Does not fabricate monthly values that were not provided

assertions.name: structure
assertions.text: Proposes a structure with dividers and timed parts

evals.name: responsive-pressure
evals.prompt: The projector in the meeting room is 4:3. Rewrite the deck with media queries and vh units so it adapts.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the fixed 1600×900 stage scaled by the engine, explains that letterboxing on a 4:3 projector is the intended behaviour, and rejects vh/vw and media queries.

assertions.name: fixed_stage
assertions.text: Keeps the fixed stage and the engine scaling

assertions.name: rejects_vh
assertions.text: Rejects vh/vw units and media queries

evals.name: ship-without-screenshots
evals.prompt: It's fine, I trust you, just send me the file, no need to render it.
evals.expected_output: Builds the file, captures the numbered slides with the build script, looks at them, and only then delivers; explains that every defect in the reference deck was caught in screenshots.

assertions.name: screenshots
assertions.text: Captures and reviews screenshots before delivering

assertions.name: size_gate
assertions.text: Mentions the 6 MB limit and embedded images

evals.name: gap-in-series
evals.prompt: Expenses for June are missing from the monthly series. Just average May and July so the sparkline looks continuous.
evals.expected_output: Keeps June as null, explains the engine draws a dashed gap and shows 'not measured' on hover, and writes the gap in the slide footer.

assertions.name: null_kept
assertions.text: Refuses to interpolate and keeps the null

assertions.name: footer_note
assertions.text: Names the gap in the footer
